name: Rope of Izanagi
lore: When Izanagi fled the underworld of Yomi, he sealed the entrance with a great boulder and a sacred rope. The rope divides the world of the living from the dead. Its bearer can feel the boundary thinning — every trap, every hidden passage, every secret door reveals itself to one who knows where life ends and death begins.
unidentified_name: a shimenawa rope that hums with spiritual energy
